title: python-gearbox: gear strength with ISO 6336 and AGMA 2001, and finite-element analysis of gear teeth
description: Python library to check spur, helical, double helical and internal gear pairs against pitting and tooth root breakage with ISO 6336:2019 (parts 1, 2 and 3) and AGMA 2001-D04, with every factor of the standards available for inspection. It also optimises profile shifts, exports the tooth geometry to COMSOL, ABAQUS and ANSYS, and builds structured finite-element meshes of gears and gear pairs (Gmsh) that it solves for tooth bending and tooth contact with CalculiX, with post-processing along the path of contact.
thesis_university: Universidad Central "Marta Abreu" de las Villas
